words.enDefinition: piece of land where waste materials are dumped

examples.en: The old dump behind the farm takes garden waste only.
examples.zh: 农场后面那个旧「垃圾场」只收园林垃圾。

examples.en: Council lorries carry the town's rubbish to the dump at dawn.
examples.zh: 市政卡车清晨把全镇的垃圾运往「垃圾场」。

words.enDefinition: succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence

examples.en: He hummed the theme tune of the cartoon all day.
examples.zh: 他一整天都哼着那部动画片主题曲的「曲调」。

examples.en: She played a simple folk tune on her new flute.
examples.zh: 她用新长笛吹了一支简单的民歌「小调」。

words.enDefinition: catch for locking a door

examples.en: Hang your wet towel on the brass hook by the shower.
examples.zh: 把湿毛巾挂在淋浴间旁边的铜「挂钩」上。

examples.en: The rusty gate hook rattles whenever the wind picks up.
examples.zh: 一起风，院门的「挂钩」就叮当作响。

words.enDefinition: clean or organized

examples.en: Her handwriting is neat enough to read at a glance.
examples.zh: 她的字迹很「工整」，一眼就能看清。

examples.en: Keep the whole tool bench neat after every single repair.
examples.zh: 每次修理完都要把工具台收拾「整齐」。

words.enDefinition: a thick slice of meat with a bone in it, such as a pork or lamb chop

examples.en: Grill the lamb chops about six minutes on each side.
examples.zh: 羊「排」每面大约烤六分钟。

examples.en: Dad seasoned the thick pork chop with rosemary and thyme.
examples.zh: 爸爸用迷迭香和百里香给猪「排」调味。

words.enDefinition: the back of a military formation or procession

examples.en: The garden at the rear of the cottage gets evening sun.
examples.zh: 小屋「后面」的花园照得到夕阳。

examples.en: Load the bikes through the rear door of the van.
examples.zh: 把自行车从面包车的「后门」装进去。

words.enDefinition: musical percussion instrument; usually consists of a hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched across each end

examples.en: The festival drum could be heard across the whole field.
examples.zh: 整个田野都能听到节庆的「鼓」声。

examples.en: He practises the drum in the garage to spare the neighbours.
examples.zh: 他在车库里练「鼓」，免得吵到邻居。

words.enDefinition: a state of peace and quiet; stillness of wind or water

examples.en: A strange calm settled over the harbour before the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴来临前，海港上空笼罩着一种奇特的「平静」。

examples.en: The early morning mountain lake lay in perfect, windless calm.
examples.zh: 清晨的湖面一片完美的「平静」，没有风。

words.enDefinition: an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction

examples.en: The overnight fire left the old barn in complete ruin.
examples.zh: 大火让旧谷仓彻底「毁灭」。

examples.en: The misty abbey ruins attract photographers every year in autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，修道院「废墟」都会吸引摄影师。

words.enDefinition: the point at which a liquid bubbles and turns to steam

examples.en: Bring the water to a fast boil before adding pasta.
examples.zh: 下意面前先把水烧到大「沸」。

examples.en: Watch the pot; the boil comes quickly on high heat.
examples.zh: 看好锅，大火时很快就「煮沸」。

words.enDefinition: get healthy again

examples.en: Clean the small cut well so it can heal quickly.
examples.zh: 把伤口洗净，好让它快点「愈合」。

examples.en: Her scraped knee healed quickly without any scar at all.
examples.zh: 她擦伤的膝盖「痊愈」了，一点疤都没留。

words.enDefinition: bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases

examples.en: Carry all the potatoes home in this strong paper sack.
examples.zh: 用这个结实的纸「袋」把土豆带回家。

examples.en: A whole sack of rice arrived for the food bank.
examples.zh: 一整「袋」大米送到了食物银行。

words.enDefinition: a medicine or treatment that makes an illness go away completely

examples.en: The researchers hope this new drug will truly cure patients.
examples.zh: 研究人员希望这种新药能真正「治愈」病人。

examples.en: There is still no real cure for the common cold.
examples.zh: 目前仍然没有「治愈」普通感冒的办法。

words.enDefinition: an informal conversation

examples.en: We had a long chat on the bench after the walk.
examples.zh: 散步之后，我们在长椅上「闲聊」了很久。

examples.en: A friendly morning chat with the baker starts every Saturday.
examples.zh: 每个周六都是从和面包师的友好「闲谈」开始的。

words.enDefinition: excavation in the earth from which ores and minerals are extracted

examples.en: Grandpa once worked in the coal mine beside the river.
examples.zh: 爷爷在河边那座「煤矿」工作过。

examples.en: The abandoned old silver mine opens for tours each summer.
examples.zh: 那座老「银矿」每年夏天开放参观。

words.enDefinition: put an end to a state or an activity

examples.en: He finally quit smoking completely after his daughter was born.
examples.zh: 女儿出生后，他终于「戒」了烟。

examples.en: She quit the accounting job last year to teach sailing.
examples.zh: 她「辞掉」了会计工作，去教帆船。

words.enDefinition: liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food

examples.en: Grandma's chicken soup warms the whole family on cold evenings.
examples.zh: 冷夜里，奶奶的鸡「汤」温暖着全家。

examples.en: Ladle the hot vegetable soup into bowls before it cools.
examples.zh: 趁热把「汤」舀进碗里，别让它凉了。

words.enDefinition: the bottom of a shoe or boot; the back part of a shoe or boot that touches the ground and provides elevation

examples.en: The heel of my new boot rubs on long walks.
examples.zh: 走远路时，我新「靴子」的「后跟」磨脚。

examples.en: She carefully fixed the broken heel with glue and patience.
examples.zh: 她用胶水和耐心修好了断掉的「鞋跟」。

words.enDefinition: belonging to or associated with a female person or animal previously mentioned

examples.en: That red umbrella by the door is hers, not mine.
examples.zh: 门边那把红伞是「她的」，不是我的。

examples.en: The whole garden idea was hers from the very beginning.
examples.zh: 整个主意从一开始就是「她的」。

words.enDefinition: portable shelter (usually of canvas stretched over supporting poles and fastened to the ground with ropes and pegs)

examples.en: Pitch the tent on flat ground away from the stream.
examples.zh: 把「帐篷」搭在离溪流远的平地上。

examples.en: A gust of wind flattened the old tent at midnight.
examples.zh: 半夜一阵风把旧「帐篷」吹塌了。

words.enDefinition: fine soft fibre produced by silkworms; cloth made from it

examples.en: The soft scarf is pure silk, a gift from Suzhou.
examples.zh: 这条围巾是真「丝」的，苏州带来的礼物。

examples.en: Real silk feels cool in summer and warm in winter.
examples.zh: 「丝」夏天摸着凉，冬天摸着暖。

words.enDefinition: sound recording consisting of a disk with a continuous groove; used to reproduce music by rotating while a phonograph needle tracks in the groove

examples.en: Grandpa still plays his jazz discs on the old gramophone.
examples.zh: 爷爷用老式留声机放他的爵士「唱片」。

examples.en: The installation disc sits in the drawer with the manuals.
examples.zh: 安装「光盘」和说明书一起放在抽屉里。

words.enDefinition: displeasing to the senses

examples.en: The ugly fence finally got a coat of green paint.
examples.zh: 那道「丑陋的」栅栏终于刷上了绿漆。

examples.en: An ugly public dispute split the club into two groups.
examples.zh: 一场「难堪的」争执让俱乐部分裂成两派。

words.enDefinition: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere

examples.en: Hail a passing taxi at the rank outside the station.
examples.zh: 在站外的候车点招一辆「出租车」。

examples.en: The chatty taxi driver knew a shortcut past the traffic.
examples.zh: 「出租车」司机知道一条避开拥堵的近路。

words.enDefinition: an artificial source of visible illumination

examples.en: The small desk lamp casts just enough light for reading.
examples.zh: 「台灯」的光正好够读书用。

examples.en: A hurricane lamp lit the porch during the power cut.
examples.zh: 停电时，一盏防风「灯」照亮了门廊。

words.enDefinition: to make fabric or clothes with long needles and wool

examples.en: Grandma will knit a scarf for each grandchild this winter.
examples.zh: 今年冬天奶奶要给每个孙辈「织」一条围巾。

examples.en: Learn to knit first with thick needles and chunky wool.
examples.zh: 用粗针和粗毛线学「编织」。

words.enDefinition: reduce or cause to be reduced from a solid to a liquid state, usually by heating

examples.en: The spring melt fills the streams with cold clear water.
examples.zh: 春季「融雪」让溪流灌满冰冷清澈的水。

examples.en: The summer melt of the glacier feeds the valley farms.
examples.zh: 「冰川融水」滋养着山谷的农田。

words.enDefinition: the meat of a cow, eaten as food

examples.en: The Sunday family stew needs two pounds of lean beef.
examples.zh: 周日炖菜需要两磅「牛肉」。

examples.en: He ordered sliced roast beef with vegetables at the carvery.
examples.zh: 他在烤肉店点了烤「牛肉」配蔬菜。

words.enDefinition: a thin sharp piece of metal hammered into wood to fix things together

examples.en: Hammer each nail firmly into the fence panel before painting.
examples.zh: 刷漆前把每颗「钉子」牢牢钉进围栏板。

examples.en: A loose nail caught his sleeve on the shed door.
examples.zh: 小屋门上一颗松动的「钉子」挂住了他的袖子。

words.enDefinition: draw into the mouth by creating a practical vacuum in the mouth

examples.en: The hungry newborn calf sucked milk eagerly from the bucket.
examples.zh: 新生小牛急切地从桶里「吸」奶。

examples.en: The vacuum sucks dust from every corner of the rug.
examples.zh: 吸尘器把地毯每个角落的灰尘都「吸」走。

words.enDefinition: a hard pointed growth on the heads of cattle, goats, and similar animals

examples.en: The wild mountain goat's horn is ridged along its length.
examples.zh: 山羊的「角」上有一道道棱纹。

examples.en: The bull lowered its horns and pawed the dusty ground.
examples.zh: 公牛低下「角」，用蹄刨着尘土。

words.enDefinition: cutlery used for serving and eating food

examples.en: Use a large fork to fluff the rice before serving.
examples.zh: 上桌前用「叉子」把米饭拨松。

examples.en: The best fork for the cake is the silver one.
examples.zh: 吃蛋糕最好用的「叉子」是那把银的。

words.enDefinition: an opening that permits escape or release

examples.en: Follow the glowing green signs to reach the nearest exit.
examples.zh: 跟着发亮的绿色标志走到最近的「出口」。

examples.en: The old cinema's side exit opens onto a quiet lane.
examples.zh: 电影院的侧面「出口」通向一条安静的小巷。

words.enDefinition: not sharp; unable to cut well

examples.en: This bread knife is too dull to slice the loaf.
examples.zh: 这把面包「刀」太「钝」，切不动整条面包。

examples.en: The kitchen scissors went dull after years of cutting cardboard.
examples.zh: 剪了多年硬纸板后，剪刀「钝」了。

words.enDefinition: an unfortunate development

examples.en: What a pity our picnic clashed with the town parade.
examples.zh: 野餐和游行撞期，真「可惜」。

examples.en: She took pity on the shivering stray and fed it.
examples.zh: 她「可怜」那只发抖的流浪猫，喂了它。

words.enDefinition: slight wetness

examples.en: The cold cellar walls stay damp all through the summer.
examples.zh: 整个夏天，地窖的墙都「潮湿」。

examples.en: Wipe the damp off the windows before the mould spreads.
examples.zh: 趁发霉前把窗上的「潮气」擦掉。

words.enDefinition: structure in which animals lay eggs or give birth to their young

examples.en: A thrush built its nest in the hedge beside the gate.
examples.zh: 一只画眉在门旁的树篱里筑了「巢」。

examples.en: The mother blackbird guarded her nest from the noisy jays.
examples.zh: 鸟妈妈守护着自己的「巢」，防着吵闹的松鸦。

words.enDefinition: set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge

examples.en: The final history exam starts at nine sharp on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一九点整开始历史「考试」。

examples.en: She finally passed the driving exam on her third try.
examples.zh: 她第三次尝试才通过驾驶「考试」。

words.enDefinition: (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element

examples.en: The science teacher showed us a model of an atom.
examples.zh: 科学老师给我们看了「原子」模型。

examples.en: Tiny atoms join together to form every substance around us.
examples.zh: 「原子」结合在一起，构成了我们身边的所有物质。

words.enDefinition: hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot; worn inside the shoe; reaches to between the ankle and the knee

examples.en: There is a hole in the heel of my sock.
examples.zh: 我的「袜子」脚跟处破了个洞。

examples.en: Woollen socks keep the hikers warm through the wet night.
examples.zh: 羊毛「袜」让徒步者在湿冷的夜里保持温暖。

words.enDefinition: cleansing agent made from the salts of vegetable or animal fats

examples.en: This simple glycerine soap is gentle enough for sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 这种甘油「皂」对敏感肌足够温和。

examples.en: Lather the soap up really well before rinsing the paintbrushes.
examples.zh: 洗画笔前先把「肥皂」充分打出泡沫。

words.enDefinition: mathematical element that when added to another number yields the same number

examples.en: The old garden thermometer hit zero just before dawn today.
examples.zh: 今天黎明前，花园温度计降到了「零度」。

examples.en: The new recruits started from zero, with no field experience.
examples.zh: 新队员们从「零」开始，没有任何实地经验。

words.enDefinition: a small hard swelling, or a shapeless piece of something

examples.en: She added a lump of butter to the hot vegetables.
examples.zh: 她往热蔬菜里加了一小「块」黄油。

examples.en: The doctor checked the small lump on his neck at once.
examples.zh: 医生立刻检查了他脖子上的小「肿块」。

words.enDefinition: the thick rubber ring fitted around a wheel, especially of a car or bicycle

examples.en: A flat tyre stranded us two miles from the campsite.
examples.zh: 一只「轮胎」瘪了，把我们困在离营地两英里的地方。

examples.en: Check the tyre pressure carefully before the long motorway drive.
examples.zh: 上高速长途前检查「轮胎」气压。

words.enDefinition: the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed

examples.en: The little bakery's fame spread quickly after the television visit.
examples.zh: 电视节目来过之后，小面包店的「名气」迅速传开。

examples.en: She sought neither money nor lasting fame from the research.
examples.zh: 她做这项研究既不图钱也不图「名」。

words.enDefinition: to bite food several times before swallowing it

examples.en: Chew each small mouthful slowly and carefully to help digestion.
examples.zh: 每一口都慢慢「咀嚼」，有助消化。

examples.en: The new puppy chewed the old slipper beyond recognition overnight.
examples.zh: 小狗一夜之间把拖鞋「嚼」得面目全非。

words.enDefinition: be obedient to

examples.en: Well-trained family dogs obey these simple voice commands almost immediately.
examples.zh: 训练有素的家犬几乎立刻就「服从」这些简单指令。

examples.en: Everyone must obey the safety rules on the building site.
examples.zh: 在工地上人人都要「遵守」安全规则。

words.enDefinition: tight cluster of people or things

examples.en: Tie a tight double knot so the parcel stays shut.
examples.zh: 打个双「结」，包裹就不会松开。

examples.en: A small knot of neighbours gathered at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 一小「群」邻居聚在公交站。

words.enDefinition: having a sharp acid taste like a lemon; (of milk) gone off

examples.en: The homemade lemonade is too sour without plenty of extra sugar.
examples.zh: 不多加糖的话，自制柠檬水太「酸」。

examples.en: The milk has gone completely sour in this summer heat.
examples.zh: 这么热的天，牛奶「馊」出酸味了。

words.enDefinition: blockage consisting of an object designed to fill a hole tightly

examples.en: Pull the rubber bath plug out before the water overflows.
examples.zh: 水要溢出前把浴缸「塞子」拔掉。

examples.en: Fit the rubber plug tightly into the basin's drain hole.
examples.zh: 把橡胶「塞子」紧紧塞进水池的排水孔。

words.enDefinition: socially incorrect in behavior

examples.en: It is rude to check your phone at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 吃饭时看手机很「无礼」。

examples.en: The clerk was never rude, even to the impatient customers.
examples.zh: 那位店员从不「粗鲁」，即使对不耐烦的顾客也是。

words.enDefinition: person with fair skin and hair

examples.en: Her blonde hair caught the warm late afternoon sunlight perfectly.
examples.zh: 她的「金发」映着午后暖阳。

examples.en: The blonde toddler waved cheerfully at every passer-by in the park.
examples.zh: 那个「金发的」小娃娃在公园里欢快地向每个路人挥手。

words.enDefinition: firm and making a pleasant sharp sound when bitten or crushed

examples.en: The orchard's fresh early apples are wonderfully crisp this season.
examples.zh: 这个季节果园的新鲜苹果「脆」得妙极了。

examples.en: She likes her toast crisp, almost golden at the edges.
examples.zh: 她喜欢吐司烤得「酥脆」，边缘接近金黄。

words.enDefinition: not willing to work or be active

examples.en: The lazy old cat sleeps on the radiator all afternoon.
examples.zh: 「懒猫」整个下午都睡在暖气片上。

examples.en: We spent a lazy summer Sunday reading on the porch.
examples.zh: 我们在门廊上看书，过了个「懒洋洋的」周日。

words.enDefinition: capable or worthy of being perceived

examples.en: There is a clearly noticeable difference between the two photos.
examples.zh: 两张照片之间有「明显的」差别。

examples.en: His big improvement in maths was noticeable within one term.
examples.zh: 一学期之内，他数学的进步就「看得出来」。

words.enDefinition: (of a body part) painful and sensitive; aching

examples.en: My throat is really sore after cheering at the match.
examples.zh: 在赛场上呐喊助威之后，我的「嗓子疼」。

examples.en: Heavy weekend gym sessions always leave her arms pleasantly sore.
examples.zh: 大重量训练日过后，她的手臂总会有些「酸痛」。

words.enDefinition: neat and arranged in good order

examples.en: Your desk looks wonderfully tidy after the big weekend sort-out.
examples.zh: 大扫除之后，你的书桌看起来格外「整洁」。

examples.en: Keep the tool shed tidy so everything is easy to find.
examples.zh: 把工具棚收拾「整齐」，这样找东西就方便了。

words.enDefinition: the sound made by something moving rapidly or by steam coming out of a small aperture

examples.en: The referee's sharp whistle stopped the match for a foul.
examples.zh: 裁判的「哨声」因一次犯规中止了比赛。

examples.en: He taught the young boys to whistle with two fingers.
examples.zh: 他教男孩子们用两根手指「吹口哨」。

words.enDefinition: deliberately offensive act or something producing the effect of deliberate disrespect

examples.en: Calling the stew watery was an insult to the chef.
examples.zh: 说炖菜太稀是对厨师的「侮辱」。

examples.en: He simply shrugged off the insult and kept serving customers.
examples.zh: 他对「羞辱」一笑置之，继续招呼客人。

words.enDefinition: an edge between a sidewalk and a roadway consisting of a line of curbstones (usually forming part of a gutter)

examples.en: Park parallel to the curb and leave the ramp clear.
examples.zh: 与「路缘」平行停车，把坡道口留出来。

examples.en: The kids sat on the curb sharing a bag of chips.
examples.zh: 孩子们坐在「马路牙子」上分吃一包薯条。

words.enDefinition: open and genuine; not deceitful

examples.en: Please accept our sincere thanks for the very prompt repairs.
examples.zh: 请接受我们对及时维修的「诚挚」感谢。

examples.en: Her sincere apology finally ended the week-long silence between them.
examples.zh: 她「真诚的」道歉终于结束了长达一周的冷战。

words.enDefinition: happening by chance; not planned or intended

examples.en: The stained tablecloth was accidental, so nobody blamed the child.
examples.zh: 桌布上的污渍是「意外」弄的，没人怪孩子。

examples.en: Their accidental meeting at the ferry turned into a friendship.
examples.zh: 他们在渡口的「偶然」相遇发展成了一段友谊。

words.enDefinition: not causing or capable of causing harm

examples.en: The garden spiders here are completely harmless, despite their size.
examples.zh: 尽管个头大，这里的花园蜘蛛是「无害的」。

examples.en: One harmless little joke at the party made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 聚会上一个「无伤大雅的」玩笑逗笑了所有人。

words.enDefinition: cavity or space in something

examples.en: An owl sleeps in the hollow of the old beech tree.
examples.zh: 一只猫头鹰睡在老山毛榉的「树洞」里。

examples.en: The stone path crosses a hollow where mist always gathers.
examples.zh: 小路穿过一个总是积雾的「洼地」。

words.enDefinition: restless or short-tempered under delay or opposition

examples.en: The toddler grew impatient waiting for the kettle to boil.
examples.zh: 等水烧开时，幼儿变得「不耐烦」。

examples.en: Try not to be too impatient with the first-time skaters.
examples.zh: 对第一次滑冰的人尽量别「急躁」。

words.enDefinition: cause to be embarrassed; cause to feel self-conscious

examples.en: Please do not embarrass the new waiter in front of guests.
examples.zh: 请不要在客人面前让新「服务员难堪」。

examples.en: Old baby photos always embarrass my brother at family gatherings.
examples.zh: 家庭聚会上，老照片总让我哥哥「尴尬」。

words.enDefinition: cement consisting of a sticky substance that is used as an adhesive

examples.en: Spread the wood glue thinly on both edges before pressing.
examples.zh: 按压前在两个边缘薄薄涂一层「胶」。

examples.en: The special glue dried clear, so the repair is invisible.
examples.zh: 「胶水」干后是透明的，修补处看不出来。

words.enDefinition: strong feelings of dislike

examples.en: She wiped the counter with clear disgust at the spilt milk.
examples.zh: 她带着明显的「厌恶」擦掉洒出的牛奶。

examples.en: The state of the changing rooms filled the coach with disgust.
examples.zh: 更衣室的状态让教练满心「反感」。

words.enDefinition: piece of clothing covering the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate part for each leg

examples.en: Fold the clean pants before they wrinkle in the basket.
examples.zh: 趁干净「裤子」还没在篮子里起皱就叠好。

examples.en: He bought tough waterproof pants for the muddy trail race.
examples.zh: 他为泥泞的越野赛买了防水「长裤」。

words.enDefinition: person who drinks alcohol to excess habitually

examples.en: The outreach team helps every alcoholic who asks for support.
examples.zh: 帮扶团队帮助每一位寻求支持的「酒鬼」。

examples.en: Uncle Ted stopped drinking years ago and now helps other alcoholics.
examples.zh: 泰德叔叔多年前戒了酒，如今帮助其他「酗酒者」。

words.enDefinition: excite to an abnormal condition, or chafe or inflame

examples.en: His constant drumming on the table irritates everyone at study group.
examples.zh: 他不停敲桌子，「惹恼」了学习小组的所有人。

examples.en: Rough cheap woollen scarves tend to irritate really sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 粗糙的羊毛围巾容易「刺激」特别敏感的皮肤。

words.enDefinition: kind of pain; something as sudden and painful as being stung

examples.en: A single bee sting swelled his wrist for two days.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂「蜇伤」让他的手腕肿了两天。

examples.en: Salt in a fresh open cut carries a sharp sting.
examples.zh: 盐撒进伤口会有尖锐的「刺痛」。

words.enDefinition: affect with wonder

examples.en: The magician's card tricks never fail to amaze the kids.
examples.zh: 魔术师的纸牌戏法总能「惊艳」孩子们。

examples.en: It will truly amaze you how fast the seedlings grow.
examples.zh: 幼苗长得有多快会令你「吃惊」。

words.enDefinition: almost exact but not completely accurate

examples.en: Give me the approximate total cost before we order materials.
examples.zh: 订材料前先给我「大约的」费用。

examples.en: The approximate arrival time is six fifteen, road traffic allowing.
examples.zh: 在不堵车的情况下，「大概」六点一刻到。

words.enDefinition: massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws

examples.en: A hungry black bear wandered through the campsite last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一只黑「熊」在营地附近游荡。

examples.en: Never feed a wild black bear, however harmless it seems.
examples.zh: 无论野「熊」看起来多无害，都不要喂它。

words.enDefinition: a person who is older, or higher in rank or standing

examples.en: The senior club players lead the warm-up before each match.
examples.zh: 「资历深」的队员在每场比赛前带热身。

examples.en: Respect your seniors at the club, even the quiet ones.
examples.zh: 在俱乐部要尊重「前辈」，连沉默寡言的也要尊重。

words.enDefinition: without deviation

examples.en: The morning bus goes directly to the museum without changes.
examples.zh: 这班公交「直达」博物馆，不用换乘。

examples.en: She looked directly at the jury while giving her answer.
examples.zh: 回答时她「直视着」陪审团。

words.enDefinition: to find the total number of things or people; to include something when calculating

examples.en: Count the change carefully before you leave the market stall.
examples.zh: 离开摊位前仔细「数清」找零。

examples.en: Every single vote counts in this very close club election.
examples.zh: 在这次势均力敌的俱乐部选举中，每一票都「算数」。

words.enDefinition: without any others being included or involved

examples.en: The whole trip was funded entirely by the village raffle.
examples.zh: 这次旅行的经费「完全」靠村里抽奖筹得。

examples.en: I entirely forgot the dentist appointment until the text arrived.
examples.zh: 短信到了我才「全然」想起牙医的预约。

words.enDefinition: happening at a time subsequent to a reference time

examples.en: We all went for hot chocolate afterwards and compared photos.
examples.zh: 「之后」我们去喝热巧克力，互相比较照片。

examples.en: The lecture ends at four; the workshop starts shortly afterwards.
examples.zh: 讲座四点结束，「随后」工作坊就开始。

words.enDefinition: in essence; at bottom or by one's (or its) very nature

examples.en: The plan is essentially a shorter version of last year's.
examples.zh: 这个计划「本质上」就是去年方案的缩短版。

examples.en: He is essentially shy, though he hides it with jokes.
examples.zh: 他「本质上」很害羞，只是用玩笑掩饰。

words.enDefinition: indicating exactness or preciseness

examples.en: The express train leaves precisely at six, so arrive early.
examples.zh: 火车「精确地」在六点发车，所以要早点到。

examples.en: That is precisely why we bought the much bigger tent.
examples.zh: 这「恰恰」就是我们要买更大帐篷的原因。

words.enDefinition: something that provides access (to get in or get out)

examples.en: Wait for me at the main entrance of the museum.
examples.zh: 在博物馆正「门」等我。

examples.en: A gentle ramp now leads up to the library entrance.
examples.zh: 现在有一段缓坡通向图书馆「入口」。

words.enDefinition: something with a round shape resembling a flat circular plate

examples.en: The young technician carefully labelled every backup disk by month.
examples.zh: 技术员按月份仔细给每张备份「磁盘」贴了标签。

examples.en: A little silver disk spins inside the old music box.
examples.zh: 旧音乐盒里一片银色「圆盘」旋转着。

words.enDefinition: filled with satisfaction

examples.en: Dad was satisfied with the repair after one test drive.
examples.zh: 试驾一次后，爸爸对修理结果很「满意」。

examples.en: Not a single customer left unsatisfied at the bakery opening.
examples.zh: 面包店开业当天没有一位顾客不「满意」。

words.enDefinition: hoop that covers a wheel

examples.en: The rear tire slowly lost pressure on the gravel road.
examples.zh: 在砾石路上，后「轮胎」漏了气。

examples.en: Check every spare tire carefully before the long desert drive.
examples.zh: 沙漠长途驾驶前仔细检查每只「轮胎」。

words.enDefinition: flat metal piece (usually a disc) used as money

examples.en: Toss a fair coin to decide who washes up tonight.
examples.zh: 抛「硬币」决定今晚谁洗碗。

examples.en: The grumpy old vending machine rejected my coin twice today.
examples.zh: 今天那台旧售货机两次退回我的「硬币」。

words.enDefinition: large enclosed shopping complex

examples.en: The new mall has a skating rink on the top floor.
examples.zh: 新「购物中心」顶楼有一个溜冰场。

examples.en: We beat the rain by finishing the shopping at the mall.
examples.zh: 我们在「商场」里买完东西，正好躲过了雨。

words.enDefinition: any of various small flat sweet cakes (`biscuit' is the British term)

examples.en: She baked a batch of oatmeal cookies for the match.
examples.zh: 她为比赛烤了一炉燕麦「饼干」。

examples.en: The bakery wraps each cookie separately for the school fair.
examples.zh: 面包店把每块「饼干」单独包好，供校园义卖。

words.enDefinition: fail to meet the hopes or expectations of

examples.en: He was really disappointed that the ferry left without him.
examples.zh: 渡轮没等他就开走了，他很「失望」。

examples.en: The fans were disappointed, but the team promised a comeback.
examples.zh: 球迷们很「失望」，但球队承诺会卷土重来。

words.enDefinition: rich sweet made of flavored sugar and often combined with fruit or nuts

examples.en: The pinata burst and the candy rained onto the lawn.
examples.zh: 彩罐爆开，「糖果」像雨点一样落在草坪上。

examples.en: Grandma keeps a whole tin of candy for visiting children.
examples.zh: 奶奶存了一罐「糖果」招待来访的孩子。

words.enDefinition: a small storage space built into a wall, with a door

examples.en: All the winter coats hang in the hall closet upstairs.
examples.zh: 所有冬衣都挂在楼上的「壁橱」里。

examples.en: She found the missing board games in the closet under the stairs.
examples.zh: 她在楼梯下的「储藏间」找到了丢的桌游。

words.enDefinition: in a special manner

examples.en: This gentle wooden ramp was built specially for wheelchair visitors.
examples.zh: 这条缓坡是「专门」为轮椅使用者修建的。

examples.en: The birthday cake was made specially for Grandpa's ninetieth birthday.
examples.zh: 这个蛋糕是「特意」为爷爷九十岁生日做的。

words.enDefinition: in a joyous manner

examples.en: The little puppies chased each other happily around the yard.
examples.zh: 小狗们在院子里「快乐地」互相追逐。

examples.en: She happily admitted that the secret recipe was her mother's.
examples.zh: 她「欣然」承认这个配方是她母亲的。

words.enDefinition: drawing intended to explain how something works; a drawing showing the relation between the parts

examples.en: The simple instruction diagram shows the shelf in eight steps.
examples.zh: 说明「图解」用八步展示了书架的组装。

examples.en: Draw a neat labelled diagram of the garden irrigation system.
examples.zh: 画一张花园灌溉系统的简单「示意图」。

words.enDefinition: a sudden liking, especially one that begins without much reason

examples.en: She has suddenly taken a fancy to growing bonsai trees.
examples.zh: 她忽然「迷上了」种盆景。

examples.en: Choose whatever takes your fancy at the busy bakery counter.
examples.zh: 面包柜台前，「看上」什么就选什么。

words.enDefinition: food that is discarded (as from a kitchen)

examples.en: The raccoons tip over our garbage bin almost every night.
examples.zh: 浣熊几乎每晚都把我们的「垃圾桶」翻倒。

examples.en: The city collects the garbage twice a week in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天市政每周收两次「垃圾」。

words.enDefinition: device incised to make an impression; used to secure a closing or to authenticate documents

examples.en: The red wax seal on the letter is still unbroken.
examples.zh: 信上的火漆「封印」仍然完好。

examples.en: Check the seal on the jam jar before opening it.
examples.zh: 开果酱罐前先检查「封口」。

words.enDefinition: white goods in which food can be stored at low temperatures

examples.en: The new refrigerator runs very quietly and fits the alcove.
examples.zh: 新「冰箱」运行安静，正好嵌进壁龛。

examples.en: Leave the refrigerator door firmly shut during the power cut.
examples.zh: 停电期间让「冰箱」门保持关闭。

words.enDefinition: kitchen appliance used for cooking food

examples.en: Clean the whole stove while the oven is still warm.
examples.zh: 趁烤箱还热的时候清洁「炉灶」。

examples.en: The old wood-burning stove still heats the whole cottage kitchen.
examples.zh: 老柴「火炉」温暖着整个村舍厨房。

words.enDefinition: parent of your father or mother

examples.en: Every grandparent got a hand-drawn thank-you card on Grandparents Day.
examples.zh: 祖父母节那天，每位「祖父母」都收到了手绘贺卡。

examples.en: A grandparent's funny old stories make the best bedtime listening.
examples.zh: 「祖辈」讲的老故事是最好的睡前故事。

words.enDefinition: listing of the words used in some enterprise

examples.en: Reading a short novel every night steadily builds your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 每晚读小说能稳步扩大「词汇量」。

examples.en: The professional kitchen vocabulary of a chef is surprisingly poetic.
examples.zh: 厨师的厨房「用语」出人意料地富有诗意。

words.zhGloss: 理想情况下；最理想的是
words.enDefinition: in an ideal manner
acceptedZhAnswers: 理想情况下；最理想的是

examples.en: Ideally, the paint should dry overnight before the second coat.
examples.zh: 「理想情况下」，油漆应晾一夜再刷第二遍。

examples.en: Ideally we would leave at seven to beat the traffic.
examples.zh: 「最理想的是」七点出发，避开堵车。

words.enDefinition: likely to happen, exist, or be true

examples.en: Rain is highly probable tomorrow, so bring the big umbrella.
examples.zh: 明天「很可能」下雨，带上大伞。

examples.en: The most probable cause of the leak is the old seal.
examples.zh: 漏水「最可能」的原因是旧密封圈。

words.enDefinition: something that is oriented horizontally

examples.en: Keep the wooden shelf horizontal while tightening the last screw.
examples.zh: 拧最后一颗螺丝时保持搁架「水平」。

examples.en: Check that the picture rail is horizontal with the level.
examples.zh: 用水平仪检查挂画横杆是否「水平」。

words.enDefinition: with sincerity; without pretense

examples.en: She apologised sincerely for the double booking of the hall.
examples.zh: 她为重复预订大厅「真诚地」道了歉。

examples.en: I thank you sincerely for the weeks of quiet help.
examples.zh: 对几周来默默的帮助，我「由衷地」感谢。

words.enDefinition: not reasonable; not showing good judgment

examples.en: Charging for plain tap water at a cafe is unreasonable.
examples.zh: 在咖啡馆对自来水收费是「不合理的」。

examples.en: The landlord's completely unreasonable rules pushed the tenants to complain.
examples.zh: 房东「不讲理的」规定让租户纷纷投诉。

words.enDefinition: pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money

examples.en: I left my wallet on the bench by the fountain.
examples.zh: 我把「钱包」忘在了喷泉边的长椅上。

examples.en: A slim leather wallet fits better in these travel trousers.
examples.zh: 薄薄的「皮夹」更适配这条旅行裤。

words.enDefinition: using the voice; not silently

examples.en: Read the whole recipe aloud while I chop the onions.
examples.zh: 我切洋葱时，请你把菜谱「读出声」。

examples.en: She suddenly laughed aloud at the comedian's second silly joke.
examples.zh: 听到喜剧演员的第二个段子，她「放声」笑了。

words.enDefinition: easily understood or seen through (because of a lack of subtlety)

examples.en: The clear transparent lid lets you watch the bread rise.
examples.zh: 「透明的」盖子让你能看到面团发酵。

examples.en: Her very transparent excuses fooled nobody at the busy office.
examples.zh: 她「一眼看穿的」借口在办公室骗不了任何人。

words.enDefinition: make more complicated

examples.en: Do not complicate the simple recipe with ten extra spices.
examples.zh: 别往菜谱里加十种多余的香料把事情「弄复杂」。

examples.en: Extra paperwork would only complicate an already slow refund process.
examples.zh: 额外的文书会让本就缓慢的退款流程更加「复杂」。

words.enDefinition: son of your brother or sister

examples.en: My young nephew helps me stack the firewood every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天我「侄子」帮我码柴火。

examples.en: The twins' little nephew visits the model farm each summer.
examples.zh: 双胞胎的小「侄子」每年夏天来农场。

words.enDefinition: in a manner differing from the usual or expected

examples.en: Oddly enough, the quiet little cafe was busiest on Mondays.
examples.zh: 说来「奇怪」，那家安静的小咖啡馆周一最忙。

examples.en: He dressed oddly for the beach, in a winter coat.
examples.zh: 他去海边穿得「很怪」，还套着冬大衣。

words.enDefinition: cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect

examples.en: Undo the top shirt button; the collar is too tight.
examples.zh: 领口太紧，「解开」最上面的扣子吧。

examples.en: Simply press Control Z to undo the deleted paragraph instantly.
examples.zh: 按 Ctrl+Z 就能立即「撤销」刚删的段落。

words.enDefinition: existing only in the mind or imagination

examples.en: Her imaginary friend had a name and a tiny umbrella.
examples.zh: 她「想象中的」朋友有名字，还有一把小伞。

examples.en: The treasure map marked an imaginary lake just for fun.
examples.zh: 地图上标了个「虚构的」湖，纯属好玩。

words.enDefinition: undergarment worn next to the skin and under the outer garments

examples.en: Pack extra warm underwear and socks for the three-day hike.
examples.zh: 三天徒步要多带几件「内衣」和袜子。

examples.en: Thermal underwear keeps the hardy winter fishermen warm in November.
examples.zh: 十一月的寒冬里，保暖「内衣」让钓鱼人暖和。

words.enDefinition: with one side forward or to the front

examples.en: The little shore crab moved sideways across the wet sand.
examples.zh: 小螃蟹「横着」爬过湿沙。

examples.en: Slide the heavy sofa sideways to reach the dropped coin.
examples.zh: 把沙发「侧向」推开，才能捡到掉落的硬币。

words.enDefinition: male grandchild

examples.en: Her teenage grandson visits every Sunday to mow the lawn.
examples.zh: 她的「孙子」每周日来割草。

examples.en: The proud grandfather framed a large photo of his grandson.
examples.zh: 骄傲的爷爷把「孙子」的照片装进相框。

words.enDefinition: a strike of the palms together that makes a short sound, often to show approval

examples.en: Give the young soloist a warm clap at the end.
examples.zh: 结束时给年轻独奏者热情的「掌声」。

examples.en: One loud clap from the back row started the applause.
examples.zh: 后排一声响亮的「拍手」带动了全场掌声。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being warmhearted and considerate and humane and sympathetic

examples.en: Her kindness to the new student eased his first week.
examples.zh: 她对新生的「善意」让他第一周好过多了。

examples.en: Small everyday acts of kindness cost nothing but mean much.
examples.zh: 小小的「善举」不费分文，意义却很重。

words.enDefinition: cause to be firmly attached

examples.en: Always fasten the gate latch so the goat stays in.
examples.zh: 「拴紧」门闩，别让山羊跑出去。

examples.en: Please fasten your seatbelt before the plane begins to taxi.
examples.zh: 飞机开始滑行前请「系好」安全带。

words.enDefinition: cases used to carry belongings when traveling

examples.en: The hotel porter stacked our luggage neatly on the trolley.
examples.zh: 行李员把我们的「行李」整齐地码在手推车上。

examples.en: Keep all your luggage tags until you leave the carousel.
examples.zh: 离开行李转盘前保留好「行李」牌。

words.enDefinition: take the load off (a container or vehicle)

examples.en: Unload the delivery van before the rain reaches the boxes.
examples.zh: 趁雨没淋到箱子，赶紧把货车「卸」了。

examples.en: They helped unload the whole food-bank lorry in an hour.
examples.zh: 他们一小时内就帮着把食物银行的货车「卸完」了。

words.enDefinition: daughter of your brother or sister

examples.en: My artistic niece draws tiny dragons on every spare envelope.
examples.zh: 我「侄女」在每个空闲的信封上画小龙。

examples.en: The twins' young niece won the borough school painting prize.
examples.zh: 双胞胎的小「侄女」赢得了区绘画奖。

words.enDefinition: where the air is unconfined

examples.en: The cat begs to go outdoors the moment the sun appears.
examples.zh: 太阳一露头，猫就闹着要去「户外」。

examples.en: Keep the young tomato plants outdoors until the first frost.
examples.zh: 第一次霜冻前把番茄留在「室外」。

words.enDefinition: the middle of the day

examples.en: On long rides we always rest the horses at midday.
examples.zh: 长途骑行中，我们总在「正午」让马休息。

examples.en: The busy market empties at midday and returns after three.
examples.zh: 市场「正午」时变空，三点后恢复热闹。

words.enDefinition: marked by lack of attention or consideration or forethought or thoroughness; not careful

examples.en: One single careless turn of the wrench stripped the bolt.
examples.zh: 一记「粗心的」扳手旋转把螺栓拧滑了。

examples.en: One careless labelling mistake cost the archive team a whole afternoon.
examples.zh: 「马虎的」标注让档案组浪费了一整个下午。

words.enDefinition: cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations

examples.en: Please do not annoy the neighbours again with late-night drilling.
examples.zh: 请不要深夜打钻「打扰」邻居。

examples.en: The big buzzing fly annoyed everyone at the picnic table.
examples.zh: 嗡嗡叫的苍蝇「惹恼」了野餐桌边的每个人。

words.enDefinition: within a building

examples.en: Bring the delicate potted ferns indoors before the first frost.
examples.zh: 第一次霜冻前把娇嫩的蕨类搬「进屋」。

examples.en: The new puppies stay indoors while the floor varnish dries.
examples.zh: 地板漆未干时，小狗们待在「室内」。

words.enDefinition: preserve made of the jelled juice of fruit

examples.en: The lime jelly wobbled dangerously on the shaky old trolley.
examples.zh: 青柠「果冻」在摇晃的推车上颤颤巍巍。

examples.en: Grandma's homemade blackcurrant jelly sets without any gelatine at all.
examples.zh: 奶奶的黑加仑「果冻」完全不用明胶就能凝固。

words.enDefinition: the manner in which someone utters a word

examples.en: Her pronunciation of the town's Welsh name impressed the guide.
examples.zh: 她对小镇威尔士语名的「发音」让导游赞叹。

examples.en: Good pronunciation matters more than a huge vocabulary at first.
examples.zh: 起初，好的「发音」比大「词汇量」更重要。

words.enDefinition: fail to meet the hopes or expectations of

examples.en: Do not disappoint the children; the party magician is coming.
examples.zh: 魔术师要来了，别让孩子们的期待「落空」。

examples.en: The tiny autumn harvest did not disappoint the patient gardeners.
examples.zh: 这点收成并没有让耐心的园丁「失望」。

words.enDefinition: used as intensifiers

examples.en: I am awfully sorry about the broken ceramic garden gnome.
examples.zh: 花园小矮人雕像被碰坏了，我「非常」抱歉。

examples.en: The wait felt awfully long outside the crowded exam hall.
examples.zh: 考场外的等待「极其」漫长。

words.enDefinition: consider bad or wrong

examples.en: The committee will surely disapprove of the extra lighting costs.
examples.zh: 委员会会「不赞成」额外的照明开支。

examples.en: Grandparents rarely disapprove of second helpings of dessert at Christmas.
examples.zh: 圣诞节时，祖父母很少「反对」再来一份甜点。

words.enDefinition: female grandchild

examples.en: Her talented granddaughter paints the market stall sign every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，她的「孙女」都会给市场摊位画招牌。

examples.en: The proud grandmother keeps her granddaughter's poems on the fridge.
examples.zh: 骄傲的奶奶把「孙女」的诗贴在冰箱上。

words.enDefinition: having or bringing misfortune

examples.en: It was unlucky that the key snapped on the one rainy day.
examples.zh: 偏偏在下雨那天钥匙折断，真是「倒霉」。

examples.en: He is always unlucky at cards but lucky in friends.
examples.zh: 他打牌「手气差」，交朋友却有福气。

words.enDefinition: person who tries to please or amuse

examples.en: The party entertainer juggled and made balloon animals for an hour.
examples.zh: 派对「艺人」表演了一小时杂耍和气球动物。

examples.en: A street entertainer draws a crowd faster than any sign.
examples.zh: 街头「艺人」比任何招牌都能更快聚拢人群。

words.enDefinition: feeling of disliking something or what someone is doing

examples.en: Grandma's stern disapproval of the haircut lasted exactly one day.
examples.zh: 奶奶对这个发型的「不满」恰好只持续了一天。

examples.en: He read the whole committee's disapproval in their folded arms.
examples.zh: 他从委员们抱起的双臂中读出了「不认可」。

words.enDefinition: occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion

examples.en: The little puppy's somersaults never fail to amuse the toddlers.
examples.zh: 小狗的翻滚总能「逗乐」蹒跚学步的孩子。

examples.en: He amused himself with a crossword puzzle during the delay.
examples.zh: 延误期间他玩拼图「自娱」。

words.enDefinition: metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter

examples.en: The tomato seedlings grew two centimetres in one sunny week.
examples.zh: 阳光充足的一周里，幼苗长高了两「厘米」。

examples.en: Leave a centimetre of space between the frame and the wall.
examples.zh: 画框和墙之间留出一「厘米」空隙。

words.enDefinition: (of a loan or investment) worth less than the money owed on it

examples.en: After the recent price crash, their holiday flat is underwater.
examples.zh: 价格暴跌之后，他们那套度假公寓已经「资不抵债」。

examples.en: Many of those start-ups are underwater after the funding winter.
examples.zh: 融资寒冬过后，许多初创公司都「资不抵债」了。

words.enDefinition: character set that includes letters and is used to write a language

examples.en: The colourful kindergarten wall chart teaches the alphabet with animals.
examples.zh: 幼儿园的挂图用动物教「字母表」。

examples.en: She happily recited the alphabet backwards to entertain her brother.
examples.zh: 她「倒背字母表」逗弟弟开心。

words.enDefinition: (of hair) having curls or waves

examples.en: Her curly hair springs right back up after every swim.
examples.zh: 每次游泳后，她的「卷发」立刻弹回原样。

examples.en: The little puppy's curly tail curled tighter when it slept.
examples.zh: 小狗「拳曲的」尾巴睡觉时卷得更紧。

words.enDefinition: containing or filled with salt

examples.en: The soup is too salty after the extra bouillon cube.
examples.zh: 多放了一块浓汤宝后，汤太「咸」。

examples.en: The salty sea wind dries the wet beach towels stiff.
examples.zh: 「咸的」海风把沙滩浴巾吹得硬邦邦。

words.enDefinition: full of or characterized by humor

examples.en: His warm humorous farewell speech kept the retirement dinner laughing.
examples.zh: 他「幽默的」告别演说让退休晚宴笑声不断。

examples.en: The weekly column's humorous take on commuting went viral locally.
examples.zh: 专栏对通勤的「诙谐」解读在当地刷屏。

words.enDefinition: the name used to identify the members of a family (as distinguished from each member's given name)

examples.en: Write your full surname first on the contest entry form.
examples.zh: 在比赛报名表上先写「姓」。

examples.en: The twin brothers share a surname but not a temperament.
examples.zh: 双胞胎同「姓」，性情却不同。

words.enDefinition: not important

examples.en: The missing jacket button seemed unimportant until the wedding photos.
examples.zh: 婚礼照片出来之前，掉颗扣子似乎「无关紧要」。

examples.en: No question is ever unimportant in the beginner's swimming class.
examples.zh: 在初学者游泳课上，没有哪个问题是「不重要的」。

words.enDefinition: needing moisture

examples.en: The long sunny morning climb left the whole group thirsty.
examples.zh: 长长的日晒攀登让全组人口「渴」。

examples.en: Thirsty tomato plants always droop by the middle of July.
examples.zh: 七月中旬，「缺水的」番茄总会垂下头。

words.enDefinition: an involuntary intake of breath through a wide open mouth; usually triggered by fatigue or boredom

examples.en: A huge yawn spread through the back row of the lecture.
examples.zh: 讲座后排响起一片大大的「哈欠」。

examples.en: The tiny kitten's huge yawn melted everyone in the cafe.
examples.zh: 小猫小小的「哈欠」融化了咖啡馆里的所有人。

words.enDefinition: lacking kindness

examples.en: It was unkind of them to laugh at his old bicycle.
examples.zh: 嘲笑他的旧自行车是「不厚道的」。

examples.en: One unkind comment can easily spoil a newcomer's whole week.
examples.zh: 一句「刻薄的」话能毁掉新来者一整周的心情。

words.enDefinition: photographic copy of written or printed or graphic work

examples.en: Please make a photocopy of the passport for the file.
examples.zh: 请把护照「复印」一份存档。

examples.en: The town library charges ten cents for each photocopy page.
examples.zh: 图书馆每「复印」一页收十美分。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and three

examples.en: About thirty keen neighbours joined the first ever street clean-up.
examples.zh: 大约「三十位」邻居参加了首次街道清扫。

examples.en: She ran over thirty kilometres along the canal last Sunday.
examples.zh: 上周日她沿运河跑了「三十」公里。

words.enDefinition: film about life in the western United States during the period of exploration and development

examples.en: Grandpa still watches an old black-and-white western every Sunday afternoon.
examples.zh: 每周日下午，爷爷都看一部老黑白「西部片」。

examples.en: The saloon scenes in that classic western were filmed nearby.
examples.zh: 那部经典「西部片」的酒馆场景就在附近拍摄。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and five

examples.en: The big recipe serves fifty guests at the summer fair.
examples.zh: 这份食谱够夏日集市上「五十位」客人吃。

examples.en: About fifty noisy mallard ducks gathered by the canal bridge.
examples.zh: 大约「五十只」绿头鸭聚在运河桥边。

words.enDefinition: assembly possessing high legislative powers

examples.en: The state senate debated the new transport bill all night.
examples.zh: 「参议院」通宵辩论新的交通法案。

examples.en: Her summer internship at the senate office starts in June.
examples.zh: 她在「参议院」办公室的实习六月开始。

words.enDefinition: so as to be complete; with everything necessary

examples.en: The garden was completely flooded within minutes of the cloudburst.
examples.zh: 暴雨倾盆而下，几分钟内花园就「完全」被淹了。

examples.en: I completely forgot my new umbrella inside the warm bakery.
examples.zh: 我「完全」把伞忘在温暖的面包店里了。

words.enDefinition: without speed (`slow' is sometimes used informally for `slowly')

examples.en: The rusty old ferry moves slowly across the wide bay.
examples.zh: 旧渡轮「缓缓地」横渡宽阔的海湾。

examples.en: Speak slowly and very clearly when giving directions to visitors.
examples.zh: 给游客指路时要「慢慢」说清楚。

words.enDefinition: in a relative manner; by comparison to something else

examples.en: The cottage is relatively cheap for such a central street.
examples.zh: 在这么中心的地段，这小屋「相对」便宜。

examples.en: Winter here is relatively mild compared with the nearby mountains.
examples.zh: 和山区相比，这里的冬天「较为」温和。

words.enDefinition: representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material

examples.en: This photo of the jetty won the village calendar contest.
examples.zh: 这张栈桥「照片」赢得了村庄日历大赛。

examples.en: She pinned a photo of the allotment beside her desk.
examples.zh: 她把菜园的「相片」钉在书桌旁。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and four

examples.en: The walk to the lighthouse takes forty minutes at most.
examples.zh: 走到灯塔最多要「四十」分钟。

examples.en: Roughly forty concerned neighbours signed the petition for safer crossing.
examples.zh: 大约「四十位」邻居签署了安全过街请愿书。

words.enDefinition: at this time or period; now

examples.en: The morning ferry is currently out of service for repairs.
examples.zh: 渡轮「目前」停运检修。

examples.en: She is currently learning Sign Language at the community centre.
examples.zh: 她「现在」正在社区中心学手语。

words.enDefinition: situated in or facing toward the north

examples.en: The northern trail closes every November for the elk season.
examples.zh: 「北部」步道每年十一月因麋鹿季关闭。

examples.en: Their little cottage faces the northern lights over the fjord.
examples.zh: 他们的小屋面向峡湾上空的「北极光」。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one

examples.en: The corner bakery opens at twelve sharp on winter Sundays.
examples.zh: 冬季周日面包店「十二点」整开门。

examples.en: She happily invited twelve classmates along to the end-of-term picnic.
examples.zh: 她邀请了「十二位」同学参加学期末野餐。

words.enDefinition: the state or fact of existing

examples.en: Nobody questioned the ruin's existence until the surveyor found it.
examples.zh: 在测量员发现之前，没人质疑那处遗迹的「存在」。

examples.en: The whole club owes its existence to three stubborn founders.
examples.zh: 俱乐部能「存续」全靠三位倔强的创始人。

words.enDefinition: computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange

examples.en: The remote hill cottage finally got internet access last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，偏远的小屋终于通上了「互联网」。

examples.en: The slow internet makes the video calls freeze every evening.
examples.zh: 「网络」太慢，视频通话每晚都卡住。

words.enDefinition: to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')

examples.en: The coastal cliff path was totally blocked after the landslide.
examples.zh: 滑坡之后，悬崖小径「完全」被堵死了。

examples.en: Your hiking plan is totally different from the brochure route.
examples.zh: 你的计划与手册路线「截然」不同。

words.enDefinition: many times at short intervals

examples.en: Local buses run frequently between the station and the harbour.
examples.zh: 车站与港口之间的公交「频繁」发车。

examples.en: He quite frequently forgets his own birthday, which is odd.
examples.zh: 说来奇怪，他「经常」忘记自己的生日。

words.enDefinition: in the right manner

examples.en: Fasten the horse trailer properly before starting the long drive.
examples.zh: 长途出发前把拖车「妥当地」固定好。

examples.en: The new kite flies properly only in steady coastal wind.
examples.zh: 只有在稳定的沿海风力下，风筝才能「正常」飞。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and six

examples.en: Over sixty neighbours turned up for the summer street lunch.
examples.zh: 「六十位」邻居来参加了夏日街宴。

examples.en: The oven needed nearly sixty minutes for the slow roast.
examples.zh: 慢烤差不多要「六十」分钟。

words.enDefinition: to a great degree

examples.en: The bakery's cinnamon buns are widely praised in the county.
examples.zh: 面包店的肉桂卷在全郡「广受」好评。

examples.en: This wild herb is widely used in coastal village cooking.
examples.zh: 这种香草在沿海村庄烹饪中「广泛」使用。

words.enDefinition: in a close relation or position in time or space

examples.en: The twin brothers work closely together in the family workshop.
examples.zh: 双胞胎在家族作坊里「紧密地」协作。

examples.en: Watch the bread dough closely so it does not over-proof.
examples.zh: 「密切」关注面团，以免发酵过头。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of fourteen and one

examples.en: The tide turns again about fifteen minutes after high water.
examples.zh: 高水位后大约「十五」分钟转潮。

examples.en: Only fifteen folding chairs arrived for the eighteen expected guests.
examples.zh: 来了「十五把」椅子，客人却预计有十八位。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of eighteen and one

examples.en: The village amateur choir has nineteen members this autumn season.
examples.zh: 秋季这一季，村合唱团有「十九」名成员。

examples.en: The little tram runs every nineteen minutes on market days.
examples.zh: 集市日电车每「十九」分钟一班。

words.enDefinition: neutral achromatic color midway between white and black

examples.en: The gray stone cottage blends quietly into the October mist.
examples.zh: 「灰色的」石屋融进十月的雾里。

examples.en: Grandpa's beard turned gray the winter the twins were born.
examples.zh: 双胞胎出生那年冬天，爷爷的胡须变「灰白」了。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and eight

examples.en: The walnut tree in the yard is nearly eighty years old.
examples.zh: 院里的核桃树快「八十」岁了。

examples.en: Grandma still cycles eighty kilometres every single week, weather permitting.
examples.zh: 天气允许时，奶奶每周骑「八十」公里。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and nine

examples.en: The calm ferry crossing takes ninety minutes in good weather.
examples.zh: 天气好时，渡轮航程要「九十」分钟。

examples.en: Almost ninety families joined the rooftop solar scheme this year.
examples.zh: 今年近「九十」户家庭加入了屋顶太阳能计划。

words.enDefinition: with strength or in a strong manner

examples.en: The coach strongly recommended the lighter pair of racing shoes.
examples.zh: 教练「强烈」推荐更轻的那双跑鞋。

examples.en: The residents strongly opposed the plan to fell the elms.
examples.zh: 居民「坚决」反对砍伐榆树的建议。

words.enDefinition: with rapid movements

examples.en: The tide rises very rapidly here, so watch your clock.
examples.zh: 这里涨潮很「快」，留意你的时间表。

examples.en: Village craft sales grew rapidly once the road was repaired.
examples.zh: 路修好之后，村里生意「迅速」增长。

words.enDefinition: in a typical manner

examples.en: The bakery typically sells out of rye bread by ten.
examples.zh: 面包店「通常」十点前就卖光黑麦面包。

examples.en: Winters here are typically mild, though last year surprised us.
examples.zh: 这里的冬天「往往」温和，去年却让人意外。

words.enDefinition: to a great depth; far down

examples.en: She breathed deeply and slowly before stepping onto the stage.
examples.zh: 上台前，她「深深地」缓慢呼吸。

examples.en: The small village was deeply shocked by the bridge closure.
examples.zh: 桥封闭的消息让全村「深感」震惊。

words.enDefinition: to a considerable degree

examples.en: It rained heavily through the whole night of the fair.
examples.zh: 集市那晚雨下得很「大」。

examples.en: The tiny little village relies heavily on its summer visitors.
examples.zh: 小镇「严重」依赖夏季游客。

words.enDefinition: the business of drawing public attention to goods and services

examples.en: The summer festival's advertising filled the station noticeboards for weeks.
examples.zh: 艺术节的「广告」贴满了车站布告栏好几周。

examples.en: Clever new window advertising doubled the bakery's long Saturday queues.
examples.zh: 巧妙的橱窗「广告」让面包店周六排队人数翻倍。

words.enDefinition: now and then or here and there

examples.en: We only occasionally hear the owl between the midnight trains.
examples.zh: 午夜列车间隙，我们「偶尔」能听到猫头鹰叫。

examples.en: Grandpa occasionally forgets his reading glasses on the greenhouse shelf.
examples.zh: 爷爷「偶尔」把眼镜落在温室架子上。

words.enDefinition: with resolute determination

examples.en: Hold the ladder firmly while I climb the last rung.
examples.zh: 我爬最后一级时，请把梯子「牢牢」扶住。

examples.en: She believes firmly that the early tides beat late crowds.
examples.zh: 她「坚信」赶早潮胜过碰晚高峰。

words.enDefinition: in a gradual manner

examples.en: Rock the picnic basket gently so the eggs stay whole.
examples.zh: 「轻轻地」摇篮子，别把蛋弄破。

examples.en: The kind night nurse spoke gently to the frightened patient.
examples.zh: 夜班护士「温和地」安抚受惊的病人。

words.enDefinition: principle that limits the extent of something

examples.en: A new parking restriction starts outside the primary school gates.
examples.zh: 校门外开始实施新的停车「限制」。

examples.en: The height restriction on the car park surprises roof-box owners.
examples.zh: 停车场的限「高」让车顶箱主人吃惊。

words.enDefinition: in a regular manner

examples.en: Water the new seedlings regularly until the roots take hold.
examples.zh: 在扎根前要「定期」给幼苗浇水。

examples.en: The book club meets regularly on the first Thursday monthly.
examples.zh: 俱乐部每月第一个周四「定期」聚会。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and seven

examples.en: About seventy brave amateur runners finished the coastal charity race.
examples.zh: 大约「七十位」勇敢的跑者完成了海岸慈善赛。

examples.en: The old orchard holds seventy apple trees of nine varieties.
examples.zh: 果园里有「七十」棵苹果树，共九个品种。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one

examples.en: The last ferry leaves at eleven, so do not linger.
examples.zh: 末班渡轮「十一点」开，别磨蹭。

examples.en: Only eleven boxes of ripe plums remained by midday Saturday.
examples.zh: 到周六中午，只剩「十一」箱李子。

words.enDefinition: in a gradual manner

examples.en: The steep forest path gradually climbs toward the ruined watchtower.
examples.zh: 林间小径「逐渐」爬向废弃的瞭望塔。

examples.en: The rescued kitten gradually trusted us over three patient weeks.
examples.zh: 三周耐心相处后，小猫「渐渐」信任了我们。

words.enDefinition: without variation or change, in every case

examples.en: The big kettle needs refilling constantly during the winter fair.
examples.zh: 冬季集市期间，水壶需要「不停地」续水。

examples.en: He constantly checks the tide table before every sailing trip.
examples.zh: 每次出海前他都「不断」查看潮汐表。

words.enDefinition: with success; in a successful manner

examples.en: The chess club successfully hosted the regional final last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天俱乐部「成功地」举办了区域决赛。

examples.en: She successfully renewed her passport without ever leaving the village.
examples.zh: 她没出村就「顺利」办好了护照续期。

words.enDefinition: to an extraordinary extent or degree

examples.en: The sturdy new jetty greatly improved the harbour's winter safety.
examples.zh: 新栈桥「大大」改善了港口冬季的安全。

examples.en: We were greatly relieved when the lost dog came home.
examples.zh: 走失的狗回家后，我们「大为」松了口气。

words.enDefinition: for a short time

examples.en: The mayor spoke briefly and warmly at the ribbon cutting.
examples.zh: 剪彩仪式上市长「简短而热情」地致辞。

examples.en: She stopped only very briefly to photograph the covered bridge.
examples.zh: 她只是「稍作」停留，拍下了廊桥。

words.enDefinition: with roughness or violence (`rough' is an informal variant for `roughly')

examples.en: The winding mountain drive takes roughly three hours without stops.
examples.zh: 这段山路不停的话「大约」要三小时。

examples.en: He measured the whole room roughly before ordering the carpet.
examples.zh: 订地毯前他「粗略」量了一下房间。

words.enDefinition: in such a manner as could not be otherwise

examples.en: Inevitably, the morning ferry waits for the last fish van.
examples.zh: 「不可避免地」，渡轮总要等最后一辆渔车。

examples.en: The discussion inevitably drifted back to the car park fees.
examples.zh: 讨论「终究」还是绕回了停车场收费问题。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of seventeen and one

examples.en: The night bus covers all eighteen stops through the villages.
examples.zh: 夜班公交串起沿途村庄的「十八」个站点。

examples.en: She has cycled the eighteen-mile loop every Sunday this year.
examples.zh: 今年每个周日她都骑完那「十八」英里的环线。

words.enDefinition: to a great extent or degree

examples.en: The efficient new boiler heats the village hall considerably faster.
examples.zh: 新锅炉让村礼堂暖得「快得多」。

examples.en: Boat repair costs rose considerably after last year's parts shortage.
examples.zh: 去年零件短缺后，修理费「大幅」上涨。

words.enDefinition: with intention; in an intentional manner

examples.en: He deliberately missed the morning bus to finish his sketch.
examples.zh: 他「故意」错过公交，好把素描画完。

examples.en: The sign was deliberately placed where every fisherman sees it.
examples.zh: 牌子被「特意」立在每位渔民都看得到的地方。

words.enDefinition: in a reflex manner

examples.en: The old greenhouse vents open automatically when the heat rises.
examples.zh: 温度升高时，温室通风口「自动」打开。

examples.en: She automatically reaches for the sieve whenever flour is out.
examples.zh: 面粉一出场，她就「下意识地」拿起筛子。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of thirteen and one

examples.en: Fourteen healthy lambs were born in the February cold snap.
examples.zh: 二月寒潮期间出生了「十四」只羊羔。

examples.en: The school bus passes our gate fourteen times a day.
examples.zh: 公交每天经过我们门口「十四」次。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of fifteen and one

examples.en: She turned sixteen on the slow ferry to the island.
examples.zh: 她在去岛的渡轮上过了「十六岁」生日。

examples.en: Sixteen hens produce more eggs than the shop can sell.
examples.zh: 「十六」只母鸡下的蛋比店里能卖的还多。

words.enDefinition: in a surprising manner

examples.en: Surprisingly, the outdoor village pool stayed open all through October.
examples.zh: 「令人惊讶的是」，露天泳池整个十月都开放。

examples.en: The humble soup won surprisingly high marks at the contest.
examples.zh: 朴素的一道汤在比赛中获得了「出奇」高的分数。

words.enDefinition: frightened or worried

examples.en: The loud firework bangs left the dog scared for days.
examples.zh: 烟花的巨响让狗「害怕」了好几天。

examples.en: She was scared of the cellar stairs as a child.
examples.zh: 小时候她「怕」地下室楼梯。

words.enDefinition: to a sufficient degree

examples.en: Let the bread dough rise sufficiently before shaping the loaves.
examples.zh: 整形前让面团「充分」发起。

examples.en: The thick rope is sufficiently strong for the heavy planter.
examples.zh: 这根绳子「足够」结实，吊得起沉重的花箱。

words.enDefinition: under normal conditions

examples.en: Yellow dandelions are commonly found in every untended village lawn.
examples.zh: 蒲公英「普遍」生长在每片无人打理的村舍草坪上。

examples.en: This aromatic herb is commonly used in coastal fish soups.
examples.zh: 这种香草在沿海鱼汤中「很常用」。

words.enDefinition: in a manner accessible to or observable by the public; openly

examples.en: The mayor publicly thanked the volunteer lifeboat crew on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五，市长「公开」感谢了志愿救生艇队。

examples.en: She publicly defended the village library against the closure plans.
examples.zh: 她「公开」为图书馆辩护，反对闭馆计划。

words.enDefinition: with low volume

examples.en: Close the front door softly; the baby just fell asleep.
examples.zh: 宝宝刚睡着，「轻轻」关门。

examples.en: Light rain fell softly on the greenhouse roof all morning.
examples.zh: 整个上午，雨「轻柔地」落在温室顶上。

words.enDefinition: someone who takes photographs professionally

examples.en: The professional wedding photographer arrived early to catch the light.
examples.zh: 婚礼「摄影师」早早到场抓拍光线。

examples.en: A local photographer documented the flood clean-up for the archive.
examples.zh: 一位本地「摄影师」把洪灾清理拍进了档案。

words.enDefinition: with regard to the body rather than the mind

examples.en: Rowing the ferry line is physically demanding work in winter.
examples.zh: 冬季摇渡轮航线在「体力上」要求很高。

examples.en: He recovered physically within weeks, but the bad memory lingered.
examples.zh: 几周内他「身体上」康复了，但记忆挥之不去。

words.enDefinition: many times; over and over

examples.en: The cheeky young cockerel repeatedly escapes into the neighbour's garden.
examples.zh: 那只小公鸡「一再」逃进邻居的花园。

examples.en: She checked the oven repeatedly, afraid of burning the tart.
examples.zh: 她「反复」检查烤箱，怕把甜派烤糊。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling food and household goods; also (groceries) the goods sold there

examples.en: Stop at the grocery on your way home for eggs.
examples.zh: 回家路上在「食品杂货店」停一下买鸡蛋。

examples.en: We picked up the weekly groceries at the corner grocery.
examples.zh: 我们在街角「杂货店」买了本周要用的食品杂货。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of twelve and one

examples.en: Thirteen fluffy goslings followed the mother across the reed bank.
examples.zh: 「十三」只小鹅跟着鹅妈妈穿过芦苇岸。

examples.en: The tram takes thirteen minutes from the bridge to the pier.
examples.zh: 电车从桥到码头要「十三」分钟。

words.enDefinition: in a very impressive manner

examples.en: Wait times dropped dramatically after the second ticket window opened.
examples.zh: 第二个售票窗口开启后，等候时间「急剧」下降。

examples.en: The sandy coastline changed dramatically after those three winter storms.
examples.zh: 那三场冬季风暴过后，海岸线「显著」改变。

words.enDefinition: in an exhaustive manner

examples.en: Dry the tent thoroughly in the sun before packing it away.
examples.zh: 收帐篷前先在太阳下「彻底」晒干。

examples.en: She scrubbed the long harvest table thoroughly before the fair.
examples.zh: 集市前她把丰收长桌「彻底」擦洗干净。

words.enDefinition: man who is the lover of a girl or young woman

examples.en: My older sister's boyfriend fixes bicycles at the weekend market.
examples.zh: 我姐姐的「男朋友」周末在集市修自行车。

examples.en: Her loving boyfriend proposed on the old pier at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分，她「男友」在老码头上求婚了。

words.enDefinition: with little force or weight; also not seriously

examples.en: She closed the heavy door as lightly as she could.
examples.zh: 她尽量「轻轻地」关上门。

examples.en: Tap the window glass lightly to get the cat's attention.
examples.zh: 「轻轻」敲一敲玻璃，引起猫的注意。

words.enDefinition: in an aroused state

examples.en: The children were excited about the first snow of term.
examples.zh: 孩子们为学期第一场雪而「兴奋」。

examples.en: He sounded excited on the phone about the sea trial.
examples.zh: 电话里他的声音因海上试航而「兴奋」。

words.enDefinition: according to tradition; in a traditional manner

examples.en: The village families traditionally open the well-dressing on Whit Monday.
examples.zh: 村民「传统上」在圣灵降临节揭开水井花饰。

examples.en: This fish soup is traditionally served at the midsummer bonfire.
examples.zh: 这道汤「按传统」要在仲夏篝火旁端上桌。

words.enDefinition: in intense despair

examples.en: The allotment soil was desperately dry after three rainless weeks.
examples.zh: 三周无雨后，菜园「极度」干燥。

examples.en: He desperately wanted the last seat on the night ferry.
examples.zh: 他「拼命」想得到夜班渡轮最后一个座位。

words.enDefinition: in your mind

examples.en: She mentally rehearsed the toast all the way to the hall.
examples.zh: 去礼堂的路上她在「心里」演练祝酒词。

examples.en: The long chess final drains you mentally more than physically.
examples.zh: 象棋决赛「精神上」的消耗比体力上更大。

words.enDefinition: unable to think clearly or understand something; mixed up

examples.en: The Swedish flat-pack instructions left him completely confused within minutes.
examples.zh: 板式家具说明书几分钟就把他弄得「一头雾水」。

examples.en: She was badly confused by the two similar road signs.
examples.zh: 两个相似的路牌让她「迷惑」。

words.enDefinition: in an accurate manner

examples.en: Spell the village name correctly or the post goes astray.
examples.zh: 把村名拼写「正确」，否则邮件会寄丢。

examples.en: Fit the spare wheel correctly before driving to the garage.
examples.zh: 开车去修理厂前，把备胎「正确」装好。

words.enDefinition: in an unfortunate way

examples.en: Sadly, the much-loved old boathouse was demolished without warning last month.
examples.zh: 「可惜的是」，深受喜爱的老船屋上个月被拆了。

examples.en: He shook his head sadly at the empty nest box.
examples.zh: 望着空空的巢箱，他「伤心地」摇了摇头。

words.enDefinition: apart from others

examples.en: Wrap the glassware separately before it goes in the van.
examples.zh: 玻璃器皿装车前要「分别」包好。

examples.en: The nervous twins were assessed separately for the swimming badges.
examples.zh: 双胞胎的游泳徽章是「分开」考核的。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of sixteen and one

examples.en: Seventeen keen local cyclists signed up for the twilight ride.
examples.zh: 「十七位」热心骑手报名了暮色骑行。

examples.en: The small ferry carries seventeen cars at most per crossing.
examples.zh: 渡轮每航次最多载「十七」辆汽车。

words.enDefinition: by a particular locality

examples.en: The sweet honey is sourced locally from the clover fields.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜「在当地」的三叶草田里采得。

examples.en: She is locally famous for her damson jam at the fair.
examples.zh: 她因集市上的「布拉斯李子果酱」在当地小有名气。

words.enDefinition: at or to or toward the back or rear

examples.en: The van rolled backwards down the hill until the handbrake caught.
examples.zh: 面包车沿坡「向后」滑，直到手刹拉住。

examples.en: He cheerfully recited the alphabet backwards to entertain the twins.
examples.zh: 他「倒背」字母表逗双胞胎开心。

words.enDefinition: to a severe or serious degree

examples.en: The late spring frost severely damaged the young olive trees.
examples.zh: 春霜「严重地」损害了幼小的橄榄树。

examples.en: The safety inspector severely criticised the unsafe scaffolding on site.
examples.zh: 检查员「严厉地」批评了工地不安全的脚手架。

words.enDefinition: state of well-being characterized by emotions ranging from contentment to intense joy

examples.en: The dog's happiness is obvious the moment the lead appears.
examples.zh: 牵引绳一出现，狗的「快乐」显而易见。

examples.en: A quiet summer breakfast by the lake is pure happiness.
examples.zh: 湖边安静的早餐就是纯粹的「幸福」。

words.enDefinition: with safety; in a safe manner

examples.en: The kittens crossed the busy road safely behind their mother.
examples.zh: 小猫们跟在妈妈身后「安全地」穿过了繁忙的马路。

examples.en: Store the fireworks safely in the shed until the licensed bonfire display.
examples.zh: 把烟花「妥善安全地」存放，直到有执照的篝火晚会。

words.enDefinition: in a tight or constricted manner

examples.en: She held the hand rail tightly as the ferry lurched.
examples.zh: 渡轮颠簸时，她「紧紧地」抓住栏杆。

examples.en: Seal the jar tightly so the pickle brine stays fresh.
examples.zh: 把罐子「拧紧」，腌菜盐水才不会变味。

words.enDefinition: an entertainer who performs a dramatic or musical work for an audience

examples.en: The talented street performer drew a crowd outside the bakery.
examples.zh: 街头「表演者」在面包店外聚起一群观众。

examples.en: Every performer gets a free meal at the folk festival.
examples.zh: 民歌节上每位「演出者」都能吃到免费餐。

words.enDefinition: at a steady rate or pace

examples.en: The calm tide rose steadily through the warm spring afternoon.
examples.zh: 温暖的春日午后，潮水「平稳地」上涨。

examples.en: Her careful handwriting improved steadily over the whole school year.
examples.zh: 一学年间，她的书写「稳步」进步。

words.enDefinition: in place of, or as an alternative to

examples.en: Alternatively, take the cliff path if the beach is crowded.
examples.zh: 「或者」，如果海滩人多，就走悬崖小径。

examples.en: You could cycle there; alternatively, the hourly boat runs at ten.
examples.zh: 你可以骑车去；「另一种选择」是坐整点船，十点一班。

words.enDefinition: on or of lower floors of a building

examples.en: The three kittens slept downstairs in the warm laundry basket.
examples.zh: 小猫们睡在「楼下」暖和的洗衣篮里。

examples.en: Grandpa's small study downstairs stays cool even in hot August.
examples.zh: 即使在炎热的八月，爷爷「楼下」的书房也很凉快。

words.zhGloss: 印象深刻的；深受感动的
words.enDefinition: deeply or markedly affected or influenced
acceptedZhAnswers: 印象深刻的；深受感动的

examples.en: The contest judges were genuinely impressed by the hand-built canoe.
examples.zh: 评委们对那只手工独木舟「印象深刻」。

examples.en: First-time visitors are always impressed by the tidy community allotments.
examples.zh: 访客们总是对整洁的社区菜园「赞不绝口」。

words.enDefinition: cheerful compliance

examples.en: Her cheerful willingness to help made the move day painless.
examples.zh: 她「乐于帮忙」的态度让搬家那天毫无痛苦。

examples.en: The whole team showed great willingness during the flood clean-up.
examples.zh: 洪灾清理期间，团队表现出极大的「意愿」。

words.enDefinition: without regard to specific details or exceptions

examples.en: Broadly speaking, the entire village supports the new footpath plan.
examples.zh: 「大体上」说，全村都支持步道计划。

examples.en: The two written estimates agree broadly on the roof cost.
examples.zh: 两份估价在屋顶费用上「大致」一致。

words.enDefinition: to a remarkable degree or extent

examples.en: The century-old wooden boat is remarkably sound below the waterline.
examples.zh: 这艘百年老船在水线以下「异常」完好。

examples.en: She remained remarkably calm while the tent collapsed around us.
examples.zh: 帐篷在我们周围塌下来时，她依然「出奇地」镇定。

words.enDefinition: in an active manner

examples.en: The rowing club actively recruits new junior members each September.
examples.zh: 赛艇俱乐部每年九月「积极」招募青少年会员。

examples.en: He actively campaigns for two safer crossings near the school.
examples.zh: 他「积极地」为学校附近更安全的过街设施奔走。

words.enDefinition: in an open way

examples.en: The town councillors discussed the budget openly in the square.
examples.zh: 议员们在广场上「公开」讨论预算。

examples.en: She openly admits that the first cake was a disaster.
examples.zh: 她「坦率地」承认第一个蛋糕做砸了。

words.enDefinition: (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that

examples.en: Answer the customs form honestly to avoid delays at the port.
examples.zh: 如实「诚实地」填写海关表格，避免港口延误。

examples.en: Honestly, the rhubarb pie was much better at last week's fair.
examples.zh: 「说实在的」，大黄派上周好吃多了。

words.enDefinition: the act of revising or altering (involving reconsideration and modification)

examples.en: She does one hour of revision every evening before the exams.
examples.zh: 考试前她每晚「复习」一小时。

examples.en: The latest contract revision added a clause about winter storms.
examples.zh: 合同的「修订」增加了关于冬季风暴的条款。

words.enDefinition: made to feel uncomfortable because of shame or wounded pride

examples.en: He was visibly embarrassed when the choir sang his name.
examples.zh: 合唱队唱到他名字时，他很「尴尬」。

examples.en: She felt embarrassed by the applause for a small favour.
examples.zh: 为小事受到掌声，她觉得「不好意思」。

words.enDefinition: for a limited time only; not permanently

examples.en: The footbridge is temporarily closed while the cables are checked.
examples.zh: 检查缆索期间，步行桥「暂时」关闭。

examples.en: We are temporarily staying at Grandma's house during the repointing.
examples.zh: 重新勾缝期间我们「临时」住在奶奶家。

words.enDefinition: used as intensifiers

examples.en: I am terribly sorry about the scratched green garden gate.
examples.zh: 花园大门被刮花了，我「非常」抱歉。

examples.en: The long queue moved terribly slowly before the holiday ferry.
examples.zh: 假期渡轮前的队伍挪得「特别」慢。

words.enDefinition: plural of penny (British currency unit)

examples.en: The price of first-class stamps rose ten pence this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，一等邮票涨价十「便士」。

examples.en: Every coin jar held a mix of pounds and pence.
examples.zh: 每个存钱罐里都混着英镑和「便士」。

words.enDefinition: for a long time without essential change

examples.en: The old drawbridge is permanently raised since the marina closed.
examples.zh: 游艇码头关闭后，吊桥「永久地」升起了。

examples.en: The dark creosote stain dyed the wooden deck permanently darker.
examples.zh: 杂酚油的污渍让甲板「永久」变深了。

words.enDefinition: a set of related web pages and resources published under a domain or URL on the World Wide Web

examples.en: The bakery's website lists today's bread by seven each morning.
examples.zh: 面包店的「网站」每天早上七点前列出当日面包。

examples.en: Check the council website for the recently revised bin days.
examples.zh: 到市政「网站」查询调整后的收垃圾日。

words.enDefinition: not adequate to give satisfaction

examples.en: Selling bruised fruit as fresh is unacceptable at any market.
examples.zh: 把碰伤的水果当新鲜货卖，在任何市场都「不可接受」。

examples.en: The noise from the compressor is unacceptable after ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 十点以后压缩机的噪音令人「无法接受」。

words.enDefinition: with bitterness, in a resentful manner

examples.en: He complained bitterly about the cancelled last ferry home on Friday.
examples.zh: 末班回家的渡轮取消后，他「愤愤地」抱怨。

examples.en: A bitterly cold east wind swept across the exposed pier.
examples.zh: 一阵「刺骨的」寒风扫过无遮挡的码头。

words.enDefinition: very recently

examples.en: The little bakery smells of freshly ground coffee at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，面包店飘着「刚」磨好的咖啡香。

examples.en: She served the trout with freshly picked dill from the garden.
examples.zh: 她用「刚从」园里「摘的」莳萝配鳟鱼。

words.enDefinition: belonging to or associated with the people or things previously mentioned

examples.en: The blue bicycles by the gate are theirs, not ours.
examples.zh: 门边那些蓝色自行车是「他们的」，不是我们的。

examples.en: The whole idea of the rooftop garden was theirs alone.
examples.zh: 屋顶花园这个主意「是他们」想出来的。

words.enDefinition: with relatively high volume

examples.en: The hungry young seagulls cried loudly above the fish stalls.
examples.zh: 饥饿的海鸥在鱼摊上空「大声」鸣叫。

examples.en: He laughed loudly enough to turn heads in the library.
examples.zh: 他在图书馆里笑得「很大声」，引得众人侧目。

words.enDefinition: emotions experienced when not in a state of well-being

examples.en: There was a real sadness in the choir's final song.
examples.zh: 合唱团的最后一首歌里有真正的「悲哀」。

examples.en: The closure of the lido left lasting sadness in the town.
examples.zh: 露天泳池的关闭给小镇留下了长久的「伤感」。

words.enDefinition: with no problems or difficulties

examples.en: The new launch slid smoothly down the slipway at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，新船「平稳地」滑下船台。

examples.en: The long committee meeting ran smoothly once the tea arrived.
examples.zh: 茶一送到，委员会会议就「顺利」进行起来。

words.enDefinition: in a nice way

examples.en: The new clerk treats the regulars nicely and remembers orders.
examples.zh: 新店员对熟客「友好」，还记得各人的订单。

examples.en: The old green garden gate is nicely painted at last.
examples.zh: 老门最终「粉刷得」很漂亮。

words.enDefinition: concurrence of opinion

examples.en: The two councils acted in accord on the flood defences.
examples.zh: 两个市政会在防洪堤问题上「意见一致」。

examples.en: The heavy old door slammed shut of its own accord.
examples.zh: 那扇门「自行」砰地关上了。

words.enDefinition: to an extreme or greatly exaggerated degree

examples.en: The grateful crowd applauded wildly as the lifeboat finally returned.
examples.zh: 救生艇终于归来时，人群「狂热地」鼓掌。

examples.en: The two written quotes differ wildly on the same roof.
examples.zh: 对同一个屋顶，两份报价相差「悬殊」。

words.enDefinition: feeling of delighted approval and liking

examples.en: The young carpentry apprentices watched the shipwright with open admiration.
examples.zh: 年轻学徒们「钦佩地」望着造船工匠。

examples.en: Her tidy allotment won the admiration of every passing neighbour.
examples.zh: 她的菜园赢得了每个路过邻居的「赞赏」。

words.enDefinition: not up to expectations

examples.en: The disappointing turnout forced the committee to cancel the concert.
examples.zh: 「令人失望的」到场人数迫使委员会取消了音乐会。

examples.en: The season was disappointing for plums but kind to apples.
examples.zh: 这一年李子收成「令人失望」，苹果却不错。

words.enDefinition: in tiny pieces

examples.en: Chop the dill finely before folding it into the butter.
examples.zh: 把莳萝「切碎」再拌进黄油。

examples.en: The oak cabinet is finely sanded and ready for oil.
examples.zh: 柜子已打磨得「细密光滑」，可以上油了。

words.enDefinition: pleasant and agreeable

examples.en: The kindly ferryman waited an extra minute for the latecomers.
examples.zh: 「和蔼的」船夫为迟到的人多等了一分钟。

examples.en: A kindly elderly neighbour waters the pots whenever we travel.
examples.zh: 我们出门时，一位「慈祥的」邻居会帮忙浇花。

words.enDefinition: providing enjoyment; pleasantly entertaining

examples.en: The river guide's amusing stories kept the whole boat entertained.
examples.zh: 导游「有趣的」故事让全船人听得津津有味。

examples.en: Her amusing impression of the old headmaster lightened the meeting.
examples.zh: 她「逗趣的」校长模仿让会议气氛轻松起来。

words.enDefinition: in a violent manner

examples.en: The sea beat violently against the harbour wall that night.
examples.zh: 那晚，海浪「猛烈地」拍打着港口防波堤。

examples.en: He shook the small juice carton violently before opening it.
examples.zh: 打开前，他把果汁盒「使劲地」摇了摇。

words.enDefinition: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy

examples.en: The endless grey drizzle is depressing after bright summer days.
examples.zh: 明亮的夏日过后，连绵的灰色阴雨让人「压抑」。

examples.en: The long-abandoned cinema still has a depressing air about it.
examples.zh: 那家废弃的电影院透着「令人沮丧的」气息。

words.enDefinition: spatially or metaphorically from a higher to a lower level or position

examples.en: The steep water chute spirals downwards into the splash pool.
examples.zh: 水滑道螺旋「向下」延伸进戏水池。

examples.en: Local bread prices drifted downwards after the new bakery opened.
examples.zh: 新面包店开张后，面包价格「往下」走了。

words.enDefinition: in a relaxed manner; not rigid

examples.en: Tie the gate rope loosely so the latch still works.
examples.zh: 把院门的绳子「松松地」系上，门闩还能用。

examples.en: Her wool scarf hung loosely as she cycled the causeway.
examples.zh: 她骑过堤道时，围巾「松松地」垂着。

words.enDefinition: without advance planning

examples.en: I accidentally locked the spare garden keys inside the greenhouse.
examples.zh: 我「无意中」把备用钥匙锁进了温室。

examples.en: She accidentally dialled the bakery's number instead of the bank's.
examples.zh: 她「不小心」把电话拨给了面包店而不是银行。

words.enDefinition: on or toward a surface regarded as a base

examples.en: The long downward slope to the harbour tests your brakes.
examples.zh: 通往港口的「下坡」很考验你的刹车。

examples.en: A further downward revision of the ferry timetable disappointed commuters.
examples.zh: 渡轮时刻表的「下调」让通勤者失望。

words.enDefinition: in a willing manner

examples.en: The friendly neighbours willingly shared their ladders during the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴期间，邻居们「心甘情愿地」共用梯子。

examples.en: He willingly took the early ferry so others could sleep.
examples.zh: 他「乐意地」坐了早班渡轮，好让别人多睡会儿。

words.enDefinition: in a faithful manner

examples.en: The lighthouse keeper logged the weather faithfully for forty years.
examples.zh: 灯塔看守人四十年来「忠实地」记录天气。

examples.en: She faithfully waters the old churchyard roses every single Saturday.
examples.zh: 每周六她都「雷打不动地」给教堂墓园的玫瑰浇水。

words.enDefinition: in an awkward manner

examples.en: The new young recruit carried the oars awkwardly at first.
examples.zh: 新船员起初「笨拙地」扛着船桨。

examples.en: The big new sofa fit awkwardly through the cottage doorway.
examples.zh: 新沙发「别扭地」勉强塞过村舍的门。

words.enDefinition: regulator for controlling the flow of a liquid from a reservoir

examples.en: The kitchen faucet still drips unless you tighten it fully.
examples.zh: 不拧紧的话，厨房「水龙头」一直滴水。

examples.en: A frost-proof outside faucet protects the stable pipes each winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，防冻「龙头」保护着马厩的水管。

words.enDefinition: with much noise or loud and unpleasant sound

examples.en: The hungry herring gulls fought noisily over the harbour scraps.
examples.zh: 饥饿的海鸥「吵闹地」争抢港口的残渣。

examples.en: The old field pump churned noisily all through the night.
examples.zh: 老水泵整夜「轰隆作响」。

words.enDefinition: relating to or expressed by a writing system that uses an alphabet

examples.en: The seed drawer is arranged in alphabetical order by flower.
examples.zh: 种子抽屉按花卉名称「依字母顺序」排列。

examples.en: The guest list is alphabetical by surname at the desk.
examples.zh: 签到处的来宾名单按「姓氏字母顺序」排列。

words.enDefinition: without care or concern

examples.en: He carelessly left the heavy tool shed door open overnight.
examples.zh: 他「粗心地」让工具棚的门开了一整夜。

examples.en: White paint had been carelessly splashed across the fresh kerbstones.
examples.zh: 油漆被「随意地」溅在了新铺的路缘石上。

words.enDefinition: satisfactory or acceptable; all right

examples.en: The newly repaired ferry is okay for the short crossing.
examples.zh: 修好的渡轮跑短途航线还「可以」。

examples.en: Would it be okay to move the market to Saturday?
examples.zh: 把集市挪到周六「行吗」？

words.enDefinition: an important task that someone is sent to carry out

examples.en: The rescue mission lasted through the night on the mountain.
examples.zh: 山上的「救援任务」持续了一整夜。

examples.en: Their mission is to deliver supplies to the flood villages.
examples.zh: 他们的「任务」是把物资送到受灾村庄。

words.enDefinition: group of soldiers

examples.en: A scout troop marched at the front of the parade.
examples.zh: 一支童子军「队伍」走在游行队伍最前面。

examples.en: The whole troop camped beside the waterfall for the weekend.
examples.zh: 这支「小队」周末在瀑布旁扎营。

words.enDefinition: the activity of leading

examples.en: Her calm leadership steadied the sailing crew through the squall.
examples.zh: 她沉着「领导」让船员们在狂风中稳住了阵脚。

examples.en: The rowing club's leadership changed hands at the spring meeting.
examples.zh: 春季会议上，俱乐部的「领导班子」完成了交接。

words.enDefinition: person who is professionally engaged in the analysis and interpretation of works of art

examples.en: The village paper's regular theatre critic praised the amateur pantomime.
examples.zh: 村报的戏剧「评论家」称赞了业余哑剧表演。

examples.en: Even the toughest local critic admired the careful pier restoration.
examples.zh: 连最苛刻的本地「评论家」也赞赏码头修复工程。

words.enDefinition: to the same degree (often followed by `as')

examples.en: The raffle prizes were shared equally among the three winners.
examples.zh: 抽奖奖品在三名获胜者之间「平均」分配。

examples.en: Both little cafes are equally good for a rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 下雨的午后，两家咖啡馆「同样」不错。

words.enDefinition: citizen who has a legal right to vote

examples.en: Every registered voter in the parish received the polling card.
examples.zh: 教区每位「选民」都收到了投票卡。
